slides.headline: Your AI second brain
slides.say: I found a GitHub project that lets you turn any AI model into your personal assistant.

slides.headline: Chat with any AI model
slides.body: Connect to local or online models like GPT, Claude, or Llama
slides.say: You can chat with any AI model, online or running on your own computer.

slides.headline: 38,129 GitHub stars
slides.body: AGPL-3.0 licence · Written in Python · Since August 2021
slides.say: It has over 30 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the AGPL-3.0 licence.

slides.headline: Read the licence before self hosting
slides.body: AGPL requires sharing changes if you offer it as a service
slides.say: The AGPL licence means if you run it as a service for others, you must share your changes. Read the README and licence first.
